patch_description: Insert a skip-3 ZZ connectivity shell (ZZ gates on qubit pairs at distance three: [0,3],[1,4],[2,5],[3,6],[4,7],[5,0],[6,1],[7,2]), all sharing the existing "theta" parameter, positioned between the skip-2 ZZ block and the XX ring. This deepens long-range entanglement coverage (distance-1, 2, 3, and 4 links are now all represented) which prior evolution steps showed tightens the worst-group margin, while keeping the parameter count fixed at 2 distinct names since it reuses "theta". This should improve robustness on the hardest validation group without any parameter-efficiency cost.
